fusions.name: Trampled Scorch
fusions.desc: A trampling strike that deals 8 damage, sets the target [Burning] for 3 seconds and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Sun-Baked Circuit
fusions.desc: Circles in a ring of desert heat that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring their resistances, and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Stoked Stride
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds, and your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds. A running blaze fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Desert-Hardened Pace
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 8%. You have 10% fire resistance.
